meta.title: 为什么ISO不能碰？这个习惯要从胶卷说起！
meta.title_en: Why Can't You Touch ISO? The Habit Goes Back to Film!

scenes.title_cn: 开场：光圈、快门、ISO为何过时了？…
scenes.title_en: Opening: why have aperture, shutter, and I…
sentences: 必定都逃不过苦学这三座曝光基石。
You can't escape studying these three exposure cornerstones.
three cornerstones（三座基石）
视频创作者和传统影视工业者之间的界限已经越来越模糊。
The line between video creators and film-industry people blurs.
blurring line（界限模糊）
专业的电影人从来不使用曝光三要素。
Professional filmmakers never use the exposure triangle.
never use it（从不使用）
scenes.speak: You can't escape studying these three exposure cornerstones. The line between video creators and film-industry people blurs. Professional filmmakers never use the exposure triangle.

scenes.title_cn: 胶片时代无法换卷：现代相机里有一二十…
scenes.title_en: Film era: can't change rolls: modern camer…
scenes.context: 胶卷上机后无法随意更换。
sentences: 现代相机里有一二十个ISO档位让我们随时调用，但电影工业里感光度只有一个，ISO800。
Modern cameras offer many ISO settings, but film uses only one: ISO 800.
only ISO 800（只有ISO800）
胶卷只要挂上摄影机就无法更换，也不是无法更换，但是牵扯出的问题太多了。
Film once loaded can't be swapped easily—too many problems follow.
can't swap film（无法换卷）
scenes.speak: Modern cameras offer many ISO settings, but film uses only one: ISO 800. Film once loaded can't be swapped easily—too many problems follow.

scenes.title_cn: 换卷的代价：胶片是无法回看的，随意更…
scenes.title_en: The cost of swapping rolls: film can't be …
scenes.context: 换卷代价大，所以锁定感光度。
sentences: 胶片是无法回看的，随意更换胶卷会打乱拍摄的进度表。
Film can't be reviewed; swapping rolls breaks the schedule.
breaks schedule（打乱进度）
记录工作如果稍有疏忽，会造成后期冲印流程中不可逆转的事故。
A logging slip causes irreversible accidents in processing.
irreversible accidents（不可逆事故）
任何一个现在我们看似翻江倒海的动作，都远比以前换一盘胶卷保险的多。
Any extreme action now is far safer than swapping a roll back then.
safer than before（更保险）
scenes.speak: Film can't be reviewed; swapping rolls breaks the schedule. A logging slip causes irreversible accidents in processing. Any extreme action now is far safer than swapping a roll back then.

scenes.title_cn: 胶片作为艺术工具：胶片年代，胶卷的A…
scenes.title_en: Film as an artistic tool: in the film era,…
scenes.context: 原生感光度是画质最好的档位。
sentences: 胶卷的ASA和色温都被视作艺术表现工具，而不是曝光工具。
Film ASA and color temp were artistic tools, not exposure tools.
artistic tool（艺术工具）
除了原生感光度，其他的感光度是模拟出来的，也称数字增益。
Other than native ISO, every setting is simulated—digital gain.
digital gain（数字增益）
原生感光度是一台摄影机动态范围最大、画质最好的档位。
Native ISO has maximum dynamic range and best quality.
native ISO（原生感光度）
scenes.speak: Film ASA and color temp were artistic tools, not exposure tools. Other than native ISO, every setting is simulated—digital gain. Native ISO has maximum dynamic range and best quality.

scenes.title_cn: 800与双原生趋势：所以为了得到画质…
scenes.title_en: 800 and the dual-native trend: to get the …
scenes.context: ISO800是黄金标准，双原生是趋势。
sentences: ARRI摄影机的原生ISO就是800，被誉为黄金标准。
ARRI's native ISO is 800—the gold standard.
gold standard（黄金标准）
白天加一片ND，晚上也不需要过分曝光。
Add ND by day; no overexposure needed at night.
ND by day（白天ND）
也有导演不遵守这套法则，故意提高感光度去获得高噪点的画面。
Some directors raise ISO deliberately for grainy looks.
break the rule（打破法则）
当下最火热的技术方向是双原生甚至三原生ISO。
The hottest direction is dual-native or even triple-native ISO.
dual-native ISO（双原生ISO）
scenes.speak: ARRI's native ISO is 800—the gold standard. Add ND by day; no overexposure needed at night. Some directors raise ISO deliberately for grainy looks. The hottest direction is dual-native or even triple-native ISO.

practice: Film uses only one sensitivity: ISO 800.
Swapping film mid-shoot breaks the schedule and logging.
Film ASA and color temp were artistic, not exposure, tools.
Native ISO is the setting with max dynamic range.
800 is the practical sweet spot all brands chose.
pitfalls: Trust dozens of ISO stops for film.
The film industry locks one sensitivity: ISO 800.
Swap film rolls for bad light.
Adjust exposure, ND, or push/pull in processing instead.
Treat ISO as a pure exposure tool.
It was an artistic grain tool in the film era.
Other settings are simulated digital gain.
非原生感光度是数字增益。
ARRI, Red, Sony, Nikon, Canon all chose 800.
shifts: 用 native ISO（原生感光度）、gold standard（黄金标准）、digital gain（数字增益）
说换卷只会说 change film
用 push and pull（推充减冲）、ND filter（减光片）、log and archive（记录归档）
用 ASA grain（感光度颗粒）、artistic tool（艺术工具）、dual-native ISO（双原生ISO）
